sentences.text:
Mr. U
 Vs.
 State of Odisha and Others ..... 
 Mr. P.K
 Mr. D. Mohanty, A
 Coram:
 Dr. Justice B.R. Sarangi
 Mr. Justice G. Satapathy
 Order
09.04.2024 Order No.
This matter is taken up by hybrid mode.

Heard Mr. U.K. Samal, learned counsel for the petitioners, Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Addl.
Government Advocate for State and Mr. D. Mohanty, learned counsel for O.P. No.4.
3.

The land of the petitioners apperatining to Plot No.354, Khata No.5 of Mouza- Darlipali even though notified under 4(1) notification of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (in short "the Act"), but the same was excluded in the notification U/s.6(1) of the Act.
He further contended that the mining activities over the said land has been started without paying compensation to the petitioners.

Mr.
P.K. Muduli, learned Addl. Government Advocate is directed to take instruction as to why the above said plot has been excluded from the notification U/s. 6(1) of the Act and if at all the same has been escaped, then necessary steps be taken in accordance with law.

4. Let him file an affidavit to that extent.
5. Call this matter after two weeks.
 (DR. B.R.
